::: {#def-bootstrap-ci-normal}
#### Normal bootstrap confidence interval

The **normal bootstrap confidence interval** is

$$\hat\theta \pm z_{1 - \alpha/2} \, \widehat{\text{SE}}_\text{boot},$$

where $\widehat{\text{SE}}_\text{boot}$ is the
bootstrap standard error (@def-bootstrap-se).
:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

::: {#rem-bootstrap-ci-normal-assumptions}
#### When the normal bootstrap interval is reliable

This interval assumes that the sampling distribution of $\hat\theta$
is approximately Gaussian and centered at $\theta$,
so it can be unreliable when that distribution is skewed.
It needs only a standard error,
which takes fewer bootstrap replicates to estimate well
than the tail quantiles used by the percentile and BCa intervals
[@efron1993introduction].
:::
